dogecoin.text: @_prestwich @nic__carter To be sure I think this is a problem for exactly 0 miners of litecoin / dogecoin, but it's amusing to think of it through the hyperbolic lens of the block size wars.

@_prestwich @nic__carter All the miners who don't have the processing power and bandwidth to make blocks for both litecoin and dogecoin will be priced out of mining. The funny thing is you can't prevent merge mining.
